design_philosophy: Human, modern, editorial, premium. Intergenerational appeal. 'Ton avenir ne se devine pas. Il s'essaie.' Avoid SaaS dashboard, childish, corporate, and AI slop aesthetics. It should feel like a high-end magazine guiding you towards your future.
theme: Light mode primary with cream background (#FAF8F5) to maintain the warm, human, editorial feel.

tokens.h1: font-heading text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#1E3A8A] leading-tight
tokens.h2: font-heading text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-normal text-[#1E3A8A] tracking-tight

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. Standard padding for main sections should be py-24 or py-32. Internal card padding should be p-8 or p-10.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use asymmetrical bento grids (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4) for editorial sections. Avoid boring symmetrical grids unless listing data.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1E3A8A] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#1E3A8A]/90 hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform duration-300 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(30,58,138,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1E3A8A] border border-[#1E3A8A]/20 rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#FAF8F5] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-[#B85C5C] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#B85C5C]/90 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300

cards.floating_card: bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(30,58,138,0.06)] border border-[#1E3A8A]/5 hover:-translate-y-2 transition-transform duration-500
cards.glass_card: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-sm

components.badges: rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold bg-[#1E3A8A]/5 text-[#1E3A8A] border border-[#1E3A8A]/10
components.filters: pill-shaped tags, horizontal scrolling on mobile, bg-white border border-[#1E3A8A]/10 text-slate-600 hover:bg-[#FAF8F5] cursor-pointer transition-colors
components.forms: minimalist inputs with soft rounded full borders (rounded-xl) bg-white p-4 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1E3A8A]/20 outline-none transition-shadow
components.navigation: Light header, sticky with glassmorphism (bg-[#FAF8F5]/80 backdrop-blur-md). Logo built with text: 'moi' in Caveat + 'demain' in Manrope + red dot.
components.modals: Large rounded-[2rem] corners, plenty of white space, smooth fade and scale entrance.

patterns.hero_editorial: Split composition. Left: Massive Fraunces typography ('Ton avenir ne se devine pas. Il s'essaie.'). Right: Overlapping photos of youth and adult, styled with slight rotations and abstract 3D elements overlapping the edges to create depth.
patterns.job_directory: Annuaire métiers: Large search bar hero. Filters as pill tags. Grid of floating cards displaying job title (Fraunces), tags, salary. Mobile: vertical list with horizontal scroll filters.
patterns.job_sheet: Fiche métier: 2-column layout on desktop. Left: Sticky nav and key stats (floating glass card). Right: Rich content sections (Quotidien, Missions) using large accordions and floating cards for 'Compétences'.
patterns.life_simulator: Simulation de vie: Immersive split screen. Left side scrolling through choices (Métier, Ville, Rythme). Right side sticky visual 'Receipt' showing budget impact in real-time with smooth number counting animations.
patterns.quiz: Trouve ta voie: Distraction-free interface. One question visible at a time. Large, touch-friendly floating cards for answers. Progress bar across the top.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Cards lift slightly, buttons scale. Smooth easing.
motion.scroll_animations: Sections fade up with framer-motion as they enter the viewport. Staggered reveals for lists and grids.

media.guidelines: Use real human photos representing multiple generations (youth and adults) mixed with 3D abstract clay elements to break the corporate feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a French app. Use the text and tone exactly as requested.
Create the logo using HTML/CSS: moidemain.
Configure tailwind.config.js to include the specific colors and fonts (Fraunces, Manrope, Caveat). Extend the theme, do not overwrite completely.
Implement the 5 core experiences for the first iteration: Homepage, Job Directory, Job Sheet, Simulator, Quiz.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all key interactive elements.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and scroll reveals.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic SaaS aesthetics or heavy gradients. Stick to flat, solid premium colors and soft shadows.
Do not use complete transparent background in header or dropdowns; use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur).
Do not use `transition: all`. Be specific with transitions (e.g. `transition-transform`, `transition-colors`).
Spacing is critical. Use 2-3x more spacing than usual to create an editorial feel.
Do not center-align large blocks of text; left-align them for readability.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Ensure high contrast for text accessibility.
